_readme: Young Women class tabs (orgs/young-women/). Rendered in the browser by orgs/young-women/classes.js, so page rebuilds keep it. classes: id (URL hash), name, ages, meets, presidency [{role,name}], advisers [names], info (one short line). Leave a field null/empty to show 'Coming soon'. NO phone numbers or other personal info for youth. activities: one object per item with class = a class id or 'all' (shows in every class tab); title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), endDate (optional), time, place, details, flyer (path from site root, e.g. 'events/flyers/x.jpg'), link (optional https URL). Items hide after their date/endDate (America/Denver). all: ward-wide leaders shown on the All Young Women tab (adults: full names; presidency names already in the page's contact card are not repeated) plus handbook notes. YOUTH: FIRST NAMES ONLY.

points.t: The Young Women organization helps young women make and keep sacred covenants and deepen their conversion to Jesus Christ and His gospel.
“I am a beloved daughter of heavenly parents, with a divine nature and eternal destiny. …” The theme helps each young woman understand her divine identity and become converted to Jesus Christ.

Each class has a called president, and where possible counselors and a secretary. Class presidencies, supported by adult leaders, plan Sunday meetings, service, and activities. Advisers support and guide class presidencies as they learn and carry out their responsibilities.

Classes are organized by age, as the ward decides: bishoprics and adult Young Women leaders prayerfully decide how to organize the young women for instruction and activities. When needed, classes may meet together.
